title: 1 Thessalonians Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 1 Thessalonians 1: thanksgiving for their work of faith, the Good News that came in power, and waiting for the Son from heaven.

questions.text: Which three names open this letter?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 names Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, writing to the assembly of the Thessalonians.

answers.text: Paul, Timothy and Tychicus
Paul, Barnabas and Mark
Paul, Luke and Epaphras
Paul, Silvanus and Timothy

questions.text: What does verse 8 say has gone out from them into every place?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says the word of the Lord has been declared from them, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, and that their faith toward God has gone out in every place.

answers.text: The letters they had written to the other assemblies
Their faith toward God
The gifts they had gathered for the saints
The report of those who first opposed them

questions.text: What does verse 2 say they always do for all of them?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they always give thanks to God for all of them, mentioning them in their prayers.

answers.text: Send word to them by a faithful brother
Remember them at the breaking of bread
Give thanks to God, mentioning them in their prayers
Pray that they may be kept from affliction

questions.text: Which three things does verse 3 say they remember without ceasing?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 remembers their work of faith, labor of love, and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

answers.text: Their work of faith, labor of love and perseverance of hope
Their wisdom, knowledge and understanding
Their giving, their serving and their teaching
Their joy, their peace and their thankfulness

questions.text: What does verse 4 say they know about the brothers loved by God?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says "We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen."

answers.text: That they are blameless
That they are chosen
That they are many
That they are strong

questions.text: How does verse 5 say the Good News came to them?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says their Good News came not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance.

answers.text: In signs that were written down and read aloud to them
Through a letter that was carried to them from Macedonia
Not in word only, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance
In weakness, in much fear and with little assurance

questions.text: In what circumstances does verse 6 say they received the word?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says they became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit.

answers.text: In much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit
In quietness, with fear and trembling
In days of peace, with great gladness
In secret, with only a few who believed

questions.text: To whom does verse 7 say they became an example?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

answers.text: All who believe in Asia and in Galatia
The overseers and servants among them
Those of Caesar's household
All who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia

questions.text: According to the report of verse 9, what did they turn from, and to what?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says they turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God.

answers.text: They turned from the law to the Spirit of promise
They turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God
They turned from the rulers of this age to the assembly
They turned from fear to boldness in the Good News

questions.text: For whom does verse 10 say they wait, and what does he do?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says they wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

answers.text: For the day of the Lord, which comes as a thief in the night
For the Spirit of promise, who seals them for that day
For his Son from heaven, Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come
For the apostles to return to them at Thessalonica
